verdict.rationale: Firebase documents Cloud Firestore as a managed database requiring no server management. Client apps can read, write, listen to and query data, including offline, with realtime listeners, and Firestore supports ACID transactions and atomic batches. Server-side access is shown through the Admin SDK, MongoDB-compatible drivers, and community reports of production APIs running on Functions with Firestore as the database. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on server/Admin SDK read/write of Firestore (Admin SDK appears only as a Functions trigger, and MongoDB drivers are limited to the Enterprise edition), and a documented step-by-step database provisioning flow; community notes also flag thin server-side query options.
